page.notes: The right-edge fragments (f, n, E, xi, Q, Ar, Po, ste) are from the neighbouring page and were left out. Printed "aliíque" has an accent that may be a printer's mark. Printed "p. 1 1." read as p. 11. The line-end mark after "aliorum" is a rule or dash, not a hyphen, so the word is written whole. "obtruse-runt" keeps the printed line-end hyphen. Long s has been normalised to s throughout (e.g. suæ, Papissæ, istorum).
